acceptance: A make target or uv run command produces the report for an arbitrary window; unit tests cover every metric calculation on fixed fixtures (no live API in tests)
The report shows each dev-loop v2 target next to its baseline from _project/archive/dev-loop-v2/baseline.md
A weekly scheduled workflow uploads the report; its first live run succeeds and the artifact is linked here
dlv2-84 and dlv2-30day-metrics have a context note naming this script as their metrics collector; dlv2-30day-metrics can be closed with this report
context: Serial item after the batch. GUARDRAILS: read-only GitHub API with the default token; no new secrets; the scheduled job holds at most 1 runner. No merge while develop is frozen for 0.5.0 or during a G13 release window. No DECISION GATE beyond normal review.
description: The dev-loop v2 targets (fast tier p95 <= 7 min, medium tier p95 <= 15 min, red trunk 0, flaky retry rate < 2%, public Make targets <= 90, workflow count) were never measured; dlv2-84 and dlv2-30day-metrics are open and unstarted. The retrospective had to sample gh data by hand. Build a script under scripts/ (no new service) that computes the metrics from the GitHub API and the trunk UAT history for a date window and writes a Markdown report, plus a weekly scheduled job that uploads it as an artifact. Extra metrics: CI first-pass green, PR open->merge p50/p90, runner-hours by workflow, release lead time (rc tag to PyPI), trunk UAT pass rate, per-cell infrastructure-failure rate and the share of red shards with product signatures (rv2r-04 signal record), and the process-blocker count (tracker items titled 'UAT envelope:' with link 'uat-rubric'). Count Make targets with the dlv2-84 counting method. This script is the replacement collector for dlv2-84's metrics step. Rollback: revert its commits.
